summary: Open Core is healthy: 18 live analyses, zero open PRs, and #142 already landed the Complete token-budget raise. Layer 1 stays dark because usage still shows pr 0 and issue 0, so reputation.score remains 0. Ten automated report issues are open, including two pulses dated 2026-08-31. This week close that stack, keep #141 as the single routed issue, and run one Complete pass under the 2500 budget.
stop: Stop filing more commit and pulse self-talk issues while 130–140 are still open.
start: Start closing the automated report stack and putting human work on issue 141.
keep: Keep the usage write path and the Complete 2500-token budget from #142.

actions.title: Close automated report issues 130-140

steps: Close issues 130, 131, 132, 133, 136, 137, 138, 139, and 140 as automated noise.

actions.issueBody: Issues 130 through 140 are automated pulse, commit, self-audit, and complete reports and should be closed as noise. Leave 141 open as the single routed Complete Analysis so the GitHub surface can show real collaborative work.

steps: Run a single issue-type analysis against GitHub issue 141 only.
Confirm usage by_type.issue increments from 0 after a successful provider call.
Do not analyze the reports being closed and do not file a new issue to do this.
actions.issueBody: Issue 141 is the current Nexus Complete Analysis and the only issue that should stay open. Run one issue-type analysis on it this week so collaborative usage can move off zero.

actions.title: Run Complete once under the 2500 budget
actions.why: Usage complete is still 0 after #142 raised the token budget from 1200 to 2500 and shrunk the ask.
steps: Run one Complete analysis using the merged 2500 budget from PR #142.
Confirm usage by_type.complete increments from 0 after success.
If Complete still fails, a human lands the follow-up fix; do not auto-merge.
actions.issueTitle: Prove Complete analysis after token budget raise
actions.issueBody: PR #142 already raised the Complete token budget from 1200 to 2500 and added a test that the budget sits above the old clip. Run one Complete analysis this week and confirm usage complete moves off zero.
